The latest capture's 100-asset breadth proxy had 73 advancers and 25 decliners. It is explicitly proxy-only and does not confirm canonical broad-alt or large-cap breadth.

CFGI readings were Neutral for BTC (59.5) and the market (58), and Greed for ETH (63); scores rose versus the prior capture. These are sentiment observations, not confirmation of a sustained rotation.

The calibration context records low-confidence cohorts in which late recovery or positive price performance countered a confirmed-breakdown interpretation; this cautions against treating a retest watch as established distribution.
